name: Alan Raven
source:
He is the youngest member of your team and uses knives to fight. On the outside he seems like a normal young man, but he actually has a bit of a vile personality that leads to him changing his position based on the situation. His family background is messy, which led to him cultivating his darkness.

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.zombiekaigai&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
